segments.contextAfter: `contact`: A contact object representing the new shipping address. To maintain privacy, the shipping information is anonymized. For example, in the United States it only includes the city, state, and zip code. This provides enough information to calculate shipping costs, without revealing sensitive information until the user actually approves the purchase.
